symptom: moved my wiringPi C program to Python on the same wiring and the LED on BCM 17 never lights. wiringPi pin 0 worked before.

files.blink.py:
import wiringpi
wiringpi.wiringPiSetup()
wiringpi.pinMode(0, 1)
while True:
    wiringpi.digitalWrite(0, 1)

gold.diagnosis: wiringPi numbering is its own virtual scheme (pin 0), not BCM. On the Pi 5 use gpiozero with BCM numbers: LED(17).
